title: GameStateV2
description: Truthful client state (failure F8): session phase, integrated-save identity, player identity, and pause. save_name is the integrated server/save name, never a dimension registry key. Null means not applicable or not yet proven in the current phase; the pre-write gate requires in_world + exact save name + exact dimension + non-null player + paused == false.

blocking_screen.description: True when a screen that blocks the world render/tick path (chat, inventory, pause menu, loading) is open. Optional; absent means the bridge cannot tell.
